info.name: VTex Anti-fraud Provider Account Reports API

params.name: documentId
params.description: Id from the desired report document

items.docs: Retrieve a specific report document by its Id.

params.name: reportName
params.description:
Name of the type of report in wish to generate. The following values are accepted: 

 - `subscriptionsWithStatus` 

 - `subscriptionsScheduledBetweenDate` 

 - `subscriptionsUpdatedBetweenDate` 

 - `subscriptionsCreatedBetweenDate` 

 - `executionsBetweenDate`

params.name: email
params.description: The report is sent to the email in this field.

params.name: beginDate
params.description: Start date of the report with the format `yyyy-mm-dd`. This field is required for any type of report.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date of the report with the format `yyyy-mm-dd`. This field is required for any type of report.

items.docs:
This endpoint creates a new report in the format of a CSV file and sends it via email. You can generate one of the following reports: 

 - subscriptionsWithStatus 

 - subscriptionsScheduledBetweenDate 

 - subscriptionsUpdatedBetweenDate 

 - subscriptionsCreatedBetweenDate 

 - executionsBetweenDate
